title: Sam Altman takes the stand in trial against Elon Musk
brief: Sam Altman testified in a California federal jury trial brought by Elon Musk against OpenAI. Musk, who invested up to $38 million in OpenAI's early days before leaving to found xAI, alleges wrongdoing by Altman and president Greg Brockman; the dispute stems from the founders' fractured relationship over OpenAI's direction and governance.
